description: Declare a coming change to this agent (new model, new prompt, new tool, new role) BEFORE it ships. While the announcement is active (7 days), a drift-only shift folds into its summary instead of alarming the human; rule violations (contract, loop, new recipient) and unannounced shifts alarm exactly as before. get_scores carries the announcement under notices with the rebaseline call that accepts the new baseline; a second announce replaces the first. Needs the human's go-ahead — it mutes deliveries.
